create_GlmImageVAEArchConfig: create a GlmImageVAEArchConfig dataclass instance with VAE architecture parameters like base_dim, z_dim, and scale factors
create_GlmImageVAEConfig: create a GlmImageVAEConfig dataclass instance with architecture config and tiling options for GLM image VAE
get_vae_scale_factor: get the VAE scale factor computed from the temporal downsample tuple length
post_init: post-initialize the VAE config to set vae_scale_factor and spatial_compression_ratio on the arch config
post_init_blend_num_frames: post-initialize the VAE config to compute blend_num_frames from tile sample min and stride frame counts
